questions.q: Roughly how long should you spend on the summary in the Paper 1 exam?
questions.why: The summary is worth 15 marks; about 25 minutes keeps time for Q2 and Q3.

questions.q: Focus: problems of living near an airport. Which sentence is best for the summary?
options: Residents suffer constant noise, poor sleep and dirty air.
Another thing the text says is that residents suffer from noise.
"I haven't slept properly in years," says Mr Lee.
In my view, airports should close at night.
questions.why: Concise, own words, several ideas in one sentence; no padding, quotations or opinion.

questions.q: Your plan has only five ideas, but Text B usually has 10–15. What should you do?
options: Write longer sentences to reach 120 words
Reread for points hidden inside examples
questions.why: Ideas are often embedded in examples; generalise them to widen your range.

questions.q: Rewrite concisely in your own words for a summary: "Commuters who cycle arrive at work feeling more alert and in a better mood."
questions.model: Cycling to work improves concentration and makes people happier.
